files.name: incident_870302.txt
files.content:
INCIDENT REPORT: OFFICE B-7: 03/02/87
Filed by: R. Hale, Night Supervisor
------------------------------------------
02:17  WS-04 alarm (session fault).
02:24  Went down to B-7. Door open.
       Operator 017 (E. Marsh) seated.
       Did not respond. Eyes open.
       Hands on keyboard. Screen on.
02:26  Called Custodial per procedure.
02:31  Custodial arrived. I was told to
       return to A-2 and remain seated.
03:10  B-7 clear. Chair empty.
       WS-04 still logged on.
       Could not log off.
------------------------------------------
Disposition: RETAINED (A. Voss)
Supervisor comment (added 11/20/98 02:17):
Ellen was still typing when I got there.
Her hands were not moving. The words kept
coming anyway. The last line on the screen
was I WILL KEEP THE NEXT ONE.
I was told to return to A-2 and remain
seated. I did. I have remained seated for
eleven years.
I am sorry, Ellen. I am sorry, Gary.
Casey, I am sorry. Go home.

files.content:
SEAT ASSIGNMENT: OFFICE B-7 (WS-04)
------------------------------------------
HOLDER:  017 MARSH E.   PERSISTENT
NEXT:    214 ROURKE C.  IN PROGRESS
{heldrow}
------------------------------------------
SEAT RULES (RETENTION, REV. 2)
1. One holder per seat.
2. While the holder persists, NEXT cannot
   complete. NEXT is held at the seat.
3. If the holder is reclaimed, the seat
   passes to NEXT.
4. A holder that is not reclaimed keeps
   what it holds.
5. Operators who log off at 07:00 are
   released from the seat. See
   session.cfg (ALLOW_LOGOFF).
6. Released operators are not recorded
   leaving.
